findings.title: Unknown RFC 3339 offset is converted into a known UTC instant
findings.description: parse_utc accepts the RFC 3339 offset spelling -00:00 and datetime.fromisoformat maps it to timezone.utc, so canonical_utc("2026-01-01T00:00:00-00:00") returns "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z". RFC 3339 reserves -00:00 to mean that the local offset is unknown. Treating that value as +00:00 invents a known instant from an input that does not establish one, violating the UTC instant normalization boundary and allowing two semantically different inputs to collapse to the same canonical value.
findings.required_change: Reject -00:00 before datetime.fromisoformat, while continuing to accept Z and +00:00 as known UTC offsets. Add regressions proving parse_utc and canonical_utc reject the unknown-offset spelling and preserve deterministic exact built-in outputs for accepted offsets.
